thread:
Maya: Heads-up — need final run-of-show and lead-routing rules for Thursday's webinar. Can we lock by EOD?
Anya: Yes. Speakers confirmed (Sam, Leo, Iris). Greenroom 09:45 PT, stage 10:05 PT. Can we keep total length ~45m?
Sam: Draft outline: quick intro, benchmarking narrative, demo, customer vignette, live Q&A, CTAs. For benchmarks I want a 4-slide narrative: 1) goal, 2) dataset/prompts, 3) cost tradeoffs, 4) takeaways.
Iris: On the demo, ops requested we list the exact test prompts so they can prime the KV cache. I'll paste them in a follow-up.
Leo: Ops plan: pre-warm model for 10 minutes, run two short scripted prompts to prime cache, and set traffic to 5 rps. If latency > 300ms fall back to quantized variant.
Leo: Ops snippet for rehearsal: `curl -X POST https://staging-proxy.redwood-infer/run -d '{"model":"rwinfer-bench-2026","q":"false","input":"prime sequence"}'`
Maya: Proposed run-of-show (concise):
- 09:45 greenroom (speakers + ops)
- 10:05 intro (Maya) 3m
- 10:08 benchmark narrative (Sam) 6m
- 10:14 demo (Leo) 10m
- 10:24 customer vignette (Iris) 8m
- 10:32 live Q&A (panel) 10m
- 10:42 CTAs + lead routing callouts (Ben) 3m
Ben: Lead routing plan: registration form adds `utm_campaign=webinar_apr26` and a hidden `interest=trial` checkbox. If `interest=trial` then tag in HubSpot as "high-priority demo" else "nurture". Also add a field `preferred_contact` so SDRs can prioritize timezone-friendly callbacks.
Sam: For messaging, let's highlight "cost per 1k tokens" and a short line about predictable latency. Ben, can you draft CTA copy that mentions trial availability?
Ben: Draft done, posting in thread: "See how Redwood cuts inference costs and keeps latency predictable — request a trial for a hands-on demo". Thoughts?
Iris: Works. Also add an optional checkbox on registration: "I want an enterprise security review" which should route to AE queue.
Anya: Rehearsal schedule: 30m full run tomorrow 09:00 PT. Please upload slides to the shared drive by 18:00 PT today. I'll send invites and a slide-order doc.
Leo: Rehearsal ops checklist: 1) confirm endpoint for demo (staging-proxy), 2) provide model priming prompts, 3) verify logging and tracing is on, 4) test fallback routing.
Maya: @Leo please paste the three priming prompts here when ready. @Ben ensure form hidden fields are in place. @Iris please share customer vignette bullets (30-60 sec takeaways).
deploy-bot: Calendar invite for rehearsal created and sent to speakers + ops.
Leo: Priming prompts (ops):
1) "Summarize the customer's order intent in 20 words."
2) "Rewrite the following text to be formal and concise: <sample>"
3) "Generate a 3-bullet product recommendation from features: [A,B,C]"
Ben: Hidden fields added to HubSpot form: `interest:trial|nurture`, `enterprise_review:yes|no`, `preferred_contact:email|phone`. Testing now.
Maya: Great. If slides are uploaded by 6pm and the form fields verify, we lock the run and send speaker reminders. Thanks, team!
